Problem: Two competing brand names: header says 'JesusOnline Equip', hero and content say 'JO EQUIP'
Recommendation: Pick one public-facing name and use it consistently across header, hero, titles, and copy

Problem: 'JO EQUIP' appears 3x above the fold (header, headline, button); 'Ministry Resources Hub' appears 2x
Recommendation: Keep brand in the headline once; remove the duplicate tagline; use action language in the button

Problem: Primary CTA 'Welcome to JO EQUIP' is a greeting, not an action; users came for resources
Recommendation: Change hero button to 'Explore the 3 Channels' (link/scroll to the channels)

Problem: /welcome page mostly repeats the home page (same description, same 3 channel cards); only 2 paragraphs are unique
Recommendation: Merge the 2 unique paragraphs into the home midpage section; retire /welcome with a redirect - or give it real content (personal letter, photo, video)

Problem: Circular journey: hero button > welcome page > channel cards > back where home already pointed; 3 separate links funnel into it
Recommendation: Remove the intermediary hop; point all entry links directly at channels/content

Problem: Internal catalog numbers leak to visitors: card badges show '09.1', '09.2' (spreadsheet numbering)
Recommendation: Show simple 1,2,3 sequence numbers or none; keep internal numbering out of the UI

Problem: Orphaned page titles: sub-pages titled just 'Introduction', 'Worship' etc. give zero context from search/shared links
Recommendation: Include the parent name in the visible title (e.g. 'The Lord's Prayer Guide - Introduction')

Problem: Back links skip a level: sub-pages say 'Back to Growth Resources' instead of the direct parent hub
Recommendation: Back link should always go one level up (to the topic hub, not the channel)

Problem: Product is buried on mobile: hero = screen 1, About/Beliefs/JO APP strip = screen 2, welcome teaser = screen 3; channels start ~screen 4
Recommendation: Move channels up; demote the institutional strip below the channels or into the footer on mobile

Problem: Interface narrates itself: 'Tap a playlist to watch the videos', 'open any of them in a new tab, then download...', 'resources are linked where available'
Recommendation: Replace instructional filler with value copy (what the content is, why it matters)
Use 'View topics' / 'Explore' so users know what they'll get

Problem: Choice overload: 21 flat topic cards with no grouping, descriptions, or guidance on where to start
Recommendation: Add light grouping (e.g. Foundations / Prayer / Bible Studies) and/or a highlighted 'Start here' card

Problem: Empty cards: title + 'See Menu' only - no hint of contents (item count, PDF vs video)
Recommendation: Add a one-line description or content count/badges to each card

Problem: Greyed 'coming soon' buttons rely on hover tooltips - invisible on touch devices; mobile users see dead buttons
Recommendation: Hide unavailable buttons or show a visible 'Coming soon' label instead of a tooltip

Problem: Form doesn't actually subscribe - submits into a 'please email us' message; quietly non-functional forms erode trust
Recommendation: Either wire up the real signup (Mailchimp) or replace with an honest 'Coming soon - email us to join' notice

Problem: 'Listen' (TTS instructions) holds a top-level nav slot while Search hides behind an icon; core content is Channels/Books/Playlists
Recommendation: Move Listen under 'More'; consider giving Search more prominence

Problem: First playlist shown has only 1 video - undercuts the 'playlist' promise as the lead item
Recommendation: Order playlists by strength/depth, not fixed sequence

Problem: Redundant links: whole card is clickable AND a 'View full playlist' link goes to the same place
Recommendation: Keep one affordance (clickable card with a visual cue)

Problem: Channel hero banners spend ~350px on a title before any content - expensive on mobile
Recommendation: Reduce hero height, especially on small screens
